And though not listed on the menu, the fresh basil in the sauce worked wonderfully in concert with the other flavors, bringing a light refreshment to match the heavier richness of the alfredo...."Read Full ReviewAlex WhitakerIt was our last night in Orange Beach, Alabama. We had paddle boarded, swam, and walked the beach about as much as we could stand that day. We were beat, but we wanted one last “hoorah” before packing up the van the next morning, and we had been meaning to check out the wharf while in town, so we landed on going to Villaggio Grille.As far as restaurants go, our experience in Orange Beach had been kind of hit or miss until then. So our expectations were not very high. But the restaurant was very busy that night, so we figured that was a pretty good sign. Neither of us expected what was actually in store for us.Our server, Irena, was very kind and promptly refilled our drinks as needed and explained the menu and specials in detail. We started with the Oyster Trio - nine baked oysters including three of each of the following: Prosciutto Rockefeller, Gorgonzola & Shallot, and Manchego & Jalapeno. The Prosciutto Rockefeller and the Gorgonzola & Shallot both had intense umami flavors and were creamy, not slimy as is often the case in uncooked oysters. The shallots practically melted in my mouth. The Manchego & Jalapeno offered a brighter punch with a not-too-overwhelming heat from the jalapeno.Both of us ordered the Seafood Pasta. It included: shrimp, scallops, & crab salad, and was served over fettuccini alfredo. We are big fans of alfredo, so it was a no-brainer. We are now also big fans of Villaggio Grille.Each piece of shrimp, scallop and crab were cooked to perfection, not under or overdone in the slightest. And though not listed on the menu, the fresh basil in the sauce worked wonderfully in concert with the other flavors, bringing a light refreshment to match the heavier richness of the alfredo. One of the most important things I noticed came towards the end of the meal. I could not see any excess oil pooling at the bottom of my plate. It usually is most noticeable when the food cools off a bit and the oil begins to separate from the cream. This often happens when the chef adds too much oil to the pan on the front end. It was impressive to see the lack of oil and told me that Villaggio Grille hires quality chefs.About halfway through the meal my wife said, “This is one of the better seafood pastas I've ever had.” I could not have disagreed with her more. It was the best. Period. I dare other restaurants to do better.Order for delivery!DOORDASHTakeout Family MealsFeeds 4 People. pages.title: Italian Fusion & Seafood at The Wharf | Villaggio Grille
pages.text: 251.224.6510Order for DeliveryMake ReservationsHomeMenusLunchDinnerBrunchHappy HourDrink MenuFamily MealsSpecialsEventsWine PairingsCateringMoreAboutContactEvents At The Wharf Main Menu251.224.6510Join Our Mailing ListAbout Villaggio GrilleItalian Fusion has never tasted so good! Our talented chefs and pristine ingredients create a dining experience so enjoyable you won't want it to end!We are the first to admit we take our wine seriously! The wide range of our wine menu just confirms it. Awarded the Wine Spectator Award ten years in a row, our wine list is sure to have something for everyone. Enjoy a glass by itself, or pair a nice bottle with a delicious dish! The experienced chefs at Villaggio Grille bring life to their dishes on a daily basis. Located at the heart of The Wharf, Villaggio has developed and maintained a reputation as one of the best restaurants in the area. Our menus range from creative appetizers, salads, and sandwiches to fantastic pasta dishes, seafood, steaks and other entrees. In addition to these wonderful selections, Villaggio is also known for its scratch made "flats," which are delicious pizzas prepared in a 10,000 pound, wood fired oven.With indoor and outdoor seating, you can choose to enjoy your meal in the ambience of the dining room with a view of the open kitchen and brick pizza oven. Or if you want to be in the middle of the action, then the patio is the right choice. Being at the heart of the Wharf, you have front row seats to the famous light shows, fireworks, tournament weigh-ins and many other events that occur on main street.The staff at Villaggio Grille not only pride themselves on their superior quality of food, but also on the quality of service provided.
